source_value_bindings.label: Standing overnight repo
source_value_bindings.support_excerpt: "Effective September 17, 2026, the Federal Open Market Committee directs the Desk to: Undertake open market operations as necessary to maintain the federal funds rate in a target range of 3-3/4 to 4 percent. Conduct standing overnight repurchase agreement operations at a rate of 4.0 percent. Conduct standing overnight reverse repurchase agreement operations at an offering rate of 3.75 percent and with a per-counterparty limit of $160 billion per day.
source_value_bindings.value_context: Conduct standing overnight repurchase agreement operations at a rate of 4.0 percent.
